title: Uzbek Latin — ASCII passport style (X→KH)
description: Official Uzbek Latin (1995 alphabet) reduced to ASCII the way Uzbek names usually appear in English and passport contexts: oʻ→o, gʻ→g, x→kh, tutuq ʼ dropped, sh/ch/ng and q kept (Xoʻjayev → Khojayev). Accepts every apostrophe variant for ʻ and ʼ and the 2026 reform letters Ö Ğ Ş Ç.
notes: No official Uzbek passport transliteration table was found. X→KH follows the Kun.uz (2022) account of English/passport forms (Xoʻjayev → Khojayev); whether the MRZ keeps X is unverified.
Alternatives to generate: X→X or H; Gʻ→GH (Kun.uz: Ghaffarova); Oʻ→U (Soviet-legacy Urinov); Q→K (Kasimov); J→DJ/DZH; the plain strip of the national spelling (XOJAYEV).

All apostrophe-like characters (U+02BB, U+02BC, U+2018, U+2019, U+0027, U+0060, U+00B4, U+02B9, U+02BD, U+055A, U+FF07) are treated alike; in ASCII output both oʻ/gʻ marks and the tutuq disappear (Maʼruf → Maruf, Isʼhoq → Ishoq).
2026 reform (Oʻ→Ö, Gʻ→Ğ, Sh→Ş, Ch→Ç) passed the Senate on 10 Sept 2026; presidential signature unconfirmed as of 7 Oct 2026. The new letters, and proposal forms Ŏ Ō Ó Õ / Ǵ Ḡ, are accepted on input.
